title: Datasheets for datasets #6-#8 (cover remaining target sources)
context: Documents datasets #6-#8 so that at least one accepted datasheet exists for each of TCGA/GDC, GEO, cBioPortal, and DepMap across M0-M2. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE; COSMIC/OncoKB are non-commercial/custom (flag, never treat as open); no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. The specific datasets are selected at triage and not enumerated in the plan, so this stays a single representative task that fans out only on confirmed selection. Depends on tcga-017, cbio-018, doc-012, doc-013, partner-014.
objective: Produce gate-passed, provenance-backed datasheets for datasets #6-#8 to complete source coverage across TCGA/GDC, GEO, cBioPortal, and DepMap, each accepted upstream with effort logged.
acceptanceCriteria: Each dataset passes both gates with committed artifacts; collectively ensure >= 1 accepted datasheet exists for each of TCGA/GDC, GEO, cBioPortal, DepMap across M0-M2.
Each accepted upstream with acceptance artifact; per-dataset effort logged to show reduction vs. the M0/M1 baseline median.
